summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the static AIToolsNova site served by /app/frontend/server.js. Homepage, tool page, and favicon all render/serve correctly (HTTP 200). Web Stories nav link works and navigates to /web-stories.html. However, all 6 story thumbnail images on the listing page are broken because the HTML hardcodes absolute production URLs (https://aitoolsnova.com/web-stories/img/*.jpg) which currently return 404 from the production origin, while the same files DO exist locally at /app/web-stories/img/ and are served correctly by the preview server.

ui_bugs.issue: All 6 story cover images broken. HTML uses absolute URL https://aitoolsnova.com/web-stories/img/<hash>.jpg which returns 404 from production. Local files exist at /app/web-stories/img/<hash>.jpg and are reachable via /web-stories/img/<hash>.jpg on the preview server (verified HTTP 200). Fix: replace the 6 absolute https://aitoolsnova.com/web-stories/img/ prefixes with relative /web-stories/img/ (or root-relative) so images resolve from the same origin.

action_items: In /app/web-stories.html, replace all 6 occurrences of 'https://aitoolsnova.com/web-stories/img/' with '/web-stories/img/' (or a relative path) so thumbnails load from the preview origin. Files already exist locally.
Optional: audit other pages (e.g., /app/index.html, tool pages) for hardcoded https://aitoolsnova.com asset URLs that may 404 in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: Static HTML references absolute production origin for local assets; this couples preview/staging rendering to production availability and breaks images the moment production 404s or is blocked. Use relative or root-relative paths for own-domain assets.
server.js is a plain static server - fine for MVP; consider setting explicit Cache-Control for images and a proper Content-Type for .webp/.svg if added later.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 checks pass; broken story thumbnails fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview base URL: https://ai-tools-landing-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: '/' 200 + renders header/nav + Browse Categories; '/tools/ai-chat.html' 200 + renders tool UI; '/favicon.ico' 200; nav [data-testid=nav-web-stories] navigates to /web-stools.html which renders text/layout but all currentSrc point to https://aitoolsnova.com/web-stories/img/*.jpg (broken, prod 404). Local counterparts /web-stories/img/*.jpg serve 200 from preview. After fix, re-run listing page and confirm all thumbnails have naturalWidth > 0.
rca of the issue: web-stories.html was likely copied from production where absolute canonical asset URLs were used. In the preview environment served by /app/frontend/server.js on port 3000, the browser fetches those images from the real production domain aitoolsnova.com, which currently returns 404 for /web-stories/img/*.jpg. Since the same JPG files are present in the repo at /app/web-stories/img/ and are correctly served by the static Node server, switching those values to relative/root-relative paths resolves the issue immediately.
